prompt: `Tok` borrows its text. This function does not compile ("cannot return value referencing local variable `s`"). Tap the line that creates the problem.
explain: `s` is dropped when `make_tok` returns, so a `Tok` pointing into it would dangle. A struct holding a reference can never outlive the thing it borrows. Return an owned `String` in the struct instead, or borrow from a string passed in.
